Name: Battle Cubes
Overview:
Battle Cubes is a fast paced, action packed, multiplayer first person shooter that combines the best features from classic and modern games.

Play on Xbox Live with 16 of your friends or 31 via System Link! Have a second player drop in at any point and play with up to 2 players split screen.

You can customize your cuboid with hats!

Includes CO-OP and Competitive game modes!
